answer: Only agents who plant a verifiable zenith beacon atop the knoll can stake, their beacon’s harmonic lasting precisely one epoch; auditors sampled from a randomized oasis pool check each beacon’s frequency against a collapsing tide epoch ledger, and each cloned beacon costs 1.7W of extra transmitter power due to the ledger’s orthostatic drift—power that cannot be bulk-purchased in harmonics fitting the knoll’s altitude profile.
